message.content: {"caption":"Grouped bar chart comparing success rates for three systems with and without failure trajectories, against a no-memory reference.","description":"A grouped bar chart with Success Rate on the vertical axis, scaled from 35 to 50 with ticks at 35, 38, 41, 44, 47, and 50. The horizontal categories are Synapse, AWM, and ReasoningBank. The legend identifies teal bars as “Success only” and pale peach bars as “w/ Failure.” Printed values are: Synapse, 40.6 for Success only and 41.7 with Failure; AWM, 44.4 and 42.2; ReasoningBank, 46.5 and 49.7. Success-only rates rise across the three systems. The with-Failure rate rises slightly from Synapse to AWM, then more sharply for ReasoningBank. With Failure is higher than Success only for Synapse and ReasoningBank, but lower for AWM. A dashed horizontal reference line at 39.0 is labeled “No mem: 39.0”; all six bars are above it.","figure_type":"chart","chart_values":[{"series":"Success only","category":"Synapse","x":"Synapse","value":40.6,"value_status":"printed"},{"series":"w/ Failure","category":"Synapse","x":"Synapse","value":41.7,"value_status":"printed"},{"series":"Success only","category":"AWM","x":"AWM","value":44.4,"value_status":"printed"},{"series":"w/ Failure","category":"AWM","x":"AWM","value":42.2,"value_status":"printed"},{"series":"Success only","category":"ReasoningBank","x":"ReasoningBank","value":46.5,"value_status":"printed"},{"series":"w/ Failure","category":"ReasoningBank","x":"ReasoningBank","value":49.7,"value_status":"printed"},{"series":"No mem","category":null,"x":null,"value":39.0,"value_status":"printed"}]}
